scenarios.name: Update unavailable physical properties for a solid body

scenario_steps.name: a part containing one visible solid body is active in the MCAD Software
the body's physical properties are unavailable in the current session
the user right-clicks the body in the model browser
the Body Properties dialog opens with the body name
mass, area, volume, and the X, Y, and Z coordinates of the center of gravity show N/A
the dialog displays a body appearance selector and OK and Cancel buttons
mass, area, volume, and the center of gravity coordinates display calculated values
the solid remains highlighted behind the dialog
the user reopens Body Properties for the same body in the same session
the calculated physical properties remain displayed
